general_information.name: SORRY, COULD YOU SAY THAT AGAIN? I’M NOT SURE IF YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY HEALTH CARD OR SOMETHING ELSE. I DO HAVE A FULL NAME, BUT I’M GETTING A BIT MIXED UP WITH THE DOCUMENTS SIDE OF IT.
general_information.address: Sorry, I’m not quite following all of that. Do you mean the whole mailing address, or just the street part? I can usually remember the street okay, but the rest I get a bit tangled up with.
general_information.family_doctor_name: OH, THE DOCTOR’S NAME… I KNOW I’VE GOT ONE, BUT I’M DRAWING A BLANK ON THE FULL NAME RIGHT NOW. IT’S SOMETHING LIKE DR. SIDDIQUI, I THINK, BUT I DON’T WANT TO MUDDLE IT UP.

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly it’s been getting to sleep. It’s been going on about seven months, since my shift pattern changed, and I’ve been tired in the day too. My mood’s otherwise been stable.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to sleep properly again, without having to rely on anything.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_diagnoses: Yes — major depressive disorder, single episode, in full remission.
past_psychiatric_history.hospital_details: It was in 2009, at Scarborough General Hospital, and I was there for four days.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Yeah, I did CBT. It was around 2010, at a community clinic, and I had about 12 sessions… that’s the one I remember.; 2010.; About 12 sessions.

medications.past_medication_details: Past medication 1: Name Or Description: Citalopram.; Dose: 20 mg daily.; Dates Or Duration: It was about 18 months from 2009, and then I stopped after I’d recovered well enough.; Discontinuation Reason: It was stopped after sustained recovery.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Beer.; Quantity or frequency: Two at weekends. That’s the way I usually put it… just beer on weekends, about two.; Duration: About thirty years.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Toronto Transit Commission.; Job Title: Transit operator.; Dates: 1996 to present.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Scarborough, and it was a pretty stable childhood. Not much else really stands out, to be honest.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I did a transport diploma and started work when I was 24… that’s mostly what I remember from that time. It all feels a bit jumbled when I try to lay it out.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m remarried now — been with my current wife for 12 years. I’ve also got two adult children from my first marriage.
personal_history.future_goals: I’d like to retire in good health in a few years.
